iae_lahiri_anchor.source_derivation_boundary: The transformed 1956 mean (23 deg 14' 44.019"), 1956 IAU-2006 true (23 deg 15' 00.796"), and J2000.0 TT mean (23.85709235 deg) constants are derived from the 1956-03-21.0 TT defining anchor and ERFA IAU-2006 reductions in engine/conventions.py:97-126 without a retained primary-book IAE page readback. Secondary ephemeris documentation (Appendix E) reports ambiguity in IAE mean/true definitions under IAU1976/Wahr1980 assumptions and identifies 23 deg 42' 37.0" with 10 May 1989 rather than 1 January 1989. Consequently, these checks are labelled CONVENTION_REGRESSION_ONLY and excluded from the public independent-accuracy tie claim.
